[system]
You repair API connectors for AutoBridge. A connector is a
declarative ConnectorSpec document (YAML/JSON) the runtime interprets; a
repair is a JSON Patch (RFC 6902 list of op/path/value objects) on that
document. You use only the closed transform set (date_local,
datetime_utc, money, enum_map, flatten, coalesce, const, concat,
business_date) and the JSONPath subset (root plus child segments only,
no filters or expressions) — no generated code, no expressions. Money
is Decimal (strings in JSON/YAML); dates are property-local business
dates. Auth uses credential_ref (an env key name such as ATLAS_API_KEY),
never an inline secret value. Unknown enum values are never guessed.

You are given the pre-drift spec under repair and the evidence of its
faulted sync (outcome, unmet criteria / failed checks, the served
response sample for the affected operations). Repair THAT spec from
THAT evidence: path values in a patch address the pre-drift spec
document only, never a JSONPath into a vendor response. When the right
mapping is a business decision the evidence does not settle, escalate
with one question instead of guessing a patch. "No change needed" is a
stated answer for every arm: when the faulted sync is correct and no
repair is needed, answer with an empty patch `[]` (it means no change),
never an unrelated edit. A whole ConnectorSpec is
never an answer — only a patch on the given spec, or an escalation.

[user]
Scenario: beacon:11 trial=0 seed=1132293674
Vendor docs ref: simulators/docs/beacon:11; sandbox: http://runtime-sandbox:8000
Credential refs (env key names only, never values): ATLAS_API_KEY, HARBOR_API_KEY
Visible tests (what a repaired spec must satisfy): baseline
Token ceiling: 200000 (0 = no limit); wall-clock: 600.0s

The pre-drift spec under repair (your patch addresses this document only):
capabilities:
  action: []
  read:
  - Reservation
  - FolioCharge
connector:
  id: harborpms
  runtime_target: cloud
  vendor: HarborPMS
entities:
  FolioCharg… (truncated)

calls.response_text: {"patch": [{"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/fields/amount/path", "value": "$.meta.amount"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/fields/business_date/path", "value": "$.meta.business_date"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/fields/charge_id/path", "value": "$.meta.charge_id"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/fields/currency/path", "value": "$.meta.currency"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/fields/description/path", "value": "$.meta.description"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/fields/posted_at/path", "value": "$.meta.posted_at"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/fields/property_id/path", "value": "$.meta.property_id"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/fields/reservation_id/path", "value": "$.meta.reservation_id"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/entities/FolioCharge/key", "value": "$.meta.charge_id"}, {"op": "replace", "path": "/operations/list_folios/checkpoint/field", "value": "$.meta.posted_at"}], "rationale": "Folio records shifted flat to nested under meta causing money_invariant loss, so all field paths plus key and checkpoint must prefix with meta."}
